records.text: --- Source: P3109/D1 5.5-5.6, printed page 64-68.
fmod P3109-BLOCK is
including P3109-BLOCK-CORE .
including P3109-OMEGA-EXTREMA .
op ConvertFromBlock : Nat Format Format Format BlockProjSpec Int CodeSeq ~> CodeSeq .
op ConvertToBlock : Nat Format Format Format BlockProjSpec CodeSeq Int ~> CodeSeq .
op ConvertToBlockMaxAbsFinite : Nat Format Format Format ProjSpec BlockProjSpec CodeSeq ~> Block .
ops BlockReduceAdd BlockReduceMultiply : Nat Format Format Format ProjSpec Int CodeSeq ~> Nat .
op BlockDotProduct : Nat Format Format Format Format Format ProjSpec Int CodeSeq Int CodeSeq ~> Nat .
ops foldAdd foldMultiply foldMaximumFinite : XReal XSeq ~> XReal .
op absElements : XSeq ~> XSeq .
op pairProducts : XSeq XSeq ~> XSeq .
op computedBlock : Nat Format Format BlockProjSpec Int XSeq ~> Block .
var B : Nat .
vars FS FX FY FSY FR : Format .
vars S T : Int .
vars CS DS : CodeSeq .
vars XS YS : XSeq .
vars X Y A : XReal .
vars PS QS : ProjSpec .
var BP : BlockProjSpec .

eq [p3109-block-ops-001] :
    foldAdd(A, xnil)
    = A
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-002] :
    foldAdd(A, xcons(X, XS))
    = foldAdd(omegaAdd(A, X), XS)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-003] :
    foldMultiply(A, xnil)
    = A
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-004] :
    foldMultiply(A, xcons(X, XS))
    = foldMultiply(omegaMultiply(A, X), XS)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-005] :
    foldMaximumFinite(A, xnil)
    = A
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-006] :
    foldMaximumFinite(A, xcons(X, XS))
    = foldMaximumFinite(omegaMaximumFinite(A, X), XS)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-007] :
    absElements(xnil)
    = xnil
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-008] :
    absElements(xcons(X, XS))
    = xcons(omegaAbs(X), absElements(XS))
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-009] :
    pairProducts(xnil, xnil)
    = xnil
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

eq [p3109-block-ops-010] :
    pairProducts(xcons(X, XS), xcons(Y, YS))
    = xcons(omegaMultiply(X, Y), pairProducts(XS, YS))
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

fields.label: p3109-block-ops-011
fields.lhs: ConvertFromBlock(B, FS, FX, FR, BP, S, CS)
fields.rhs: projectUnscaled(FR, BP, blockDecode(B, FS, FX, S, CS), 0)
fields.condition: validBlock(B, FS, FX, S, CS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validBlockProjection(BP, B)

records.text:
ceq [p3109-block-ops-011] :
    ConvertFromBlock(B, FS, FX, FR, BP, S, CS)
    = projectUnscaled(FR, BP, blockDecode(B, FS, FX, S, CS), 0)
    if validBlock(B, FS, FX, S, CS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validBlockProjection(BP, B)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

fields.label: p3109-block-ops-012
fields.lhs: ConvertToBlock(B, FX, FS, FR, BP, CS, S)
fields.rhs: blockProject(B, FS, FR, BP, S, decodeElements(FX, CS))
fields.condition: B >= 1 /\ length(CS) == B /\ validCodes(FX, CS) /\ validCode(FS, S) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validBlockProjection(BP, B)

records.text:
ceq [p3109-block-ops-012] :
    ConvertToBlock(B, FX, FS, FR, BP, CS, S)
    = blockProject(B, FS, FR, BP, S, decodeElements(FX, CS))
    if B >= 1 /\ length(CS) == B /\ validCodes(FX, CS) /\ validCode(FS, S) /\ validFormat(FR) /\
    validBlockProjection(BP, B)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

fields.label: p3109-block-ops-013
fields.lhs: ConvertToBlockMaxAbsFinite(B, FX, FS, FR, PS, BP, CS)
fields.rhs: computedBlock(B, FS, FR, BP, project(FS, PS, foldMaximumFinite(nan, absElements(decodeElements(FX, CS)))) , decodeElements(FX, CS))
fields.condition: B >= 1 /\ length(CS) == B /\ validCodes(FX, CS) /\ validFormat(FS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validProjection(PS) /\ validBlockProjection(BP, B)

records.text:
ceq [p3109-block-ops-013] :
    ConvertToBlockMaxAbsFinite(B, FX, FS, FR, PS, BP, CS)
    = computedBlock(B, FS, FR, BP, project(FS, PS, foldMaximumFinite(nan,
    absElements(decodeElements(FX, CS)))) , decodeElements(FX, CS))
    if B >= 1 /\ length(CS) == B /\ validCodes(FX, CS) /\ validFormat(FS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\
    validProjection(PS) /\ validBlockProjection(BP, B)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

fields.label: p3109-block-ops-014
fields.lhs: computedBlock(B, FS, FR, BP, S, XS)
fields.rhs: block(S, blockProject(B, FS, FR, BP, S, XS))

records.text:
ceq [p3109-block-ops-014] :
    computedBlock(B, FS, FR, BP, S, XS)
    = block(S, blockProject(B, FS, FR, BP, S, XS))
    if validCode(FS, S)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

fields.label: p3109-block-ops-015
fields.lhs: BlockReduceAdd(B, FS, FX, FR, PS, S, CS)
fields.rhs: project(FR, PS, foldAdd(fin(0), blockDecode(B, FS, FX, S, CS)))
fields.condition: validBlock(B, FS, FX, S, CS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validProjection(PS)

ceq [p3109-block-ops-015] :
    BlockReduceAdd(B, FS, FX, FR, PS, S, CS)

    if validBlock(B, FS, FX, S, CS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validProjection(PS)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

fields.label: p3109-block-ops-016
fields.lhs: BlockReduceMultiply(B, FS, FX, FR, PS, S, CS)
fields.rhs: project(FR, PS, foldMultiply(fin(1), blockDecode(B, FS, FX, S, CS)))
fields.condition: validBlock(B, FS, FX, S, CS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validProjection(PS)

records.text:
ceq [p3109-block-ops-016] :
    BlockReduceMultiply(B, FS, FX, FR, PS, S, CS)
    = project(FR, PS, foldMultiply(fin(1), blockDecode(B, FS, FX, S, CS)))
    if validBlock(B, FS, FX, S, CS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validProjection(PS)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .

fields.label: p3109-block-ops-017
fields.lhs: BlockDotProduct(B, FS, FX, FSY, FY, FR, PS, S, CS, T, DS)
fields.rhs: project(FR, PS, foldAdd(fin(0), pairProducts(blockDecode(B, FS, FX, S, CS), blockDecode(B, FSY, FY, T, DS))))
fields.condition: validBlock(B, FS, FX, S, CS) /\ validBlock(B, FSY, FY, T, DS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\ validProjection(PS)

records.text:
ceq [p3109-block-ops-017] :
    BlockDotProduct(B, FS, FX, FSY, FY, FR, PS, S, CS, T, DS)
    = project(FR, PS, foldAdd(fin(0), pairProducts(blockDecode(B, FS, FX, S, CS), blockDecode(B,
    FSY, FY, T, DS))))
    if validBlock(B, FS, FX, S, CS) /\ validBlock(B, FSY, FY, T, DS) /\ validFormat(FR) /\
    validProjection(PS)
    [metadata "clause=5.5-5.6; page=64-68"] .
